While modern sports are evolving thanks to technology, the line between digital and reality has become blurry.

The filmmakers explore efforts to create sustainable methods for producing meat and plant protein, including a company in Chile developing plants and artificial intelligence and farmers in the UK rearing meat on restored dairy and crop lands.

Artificial intelligence and autonomy are no longer just the realm of science fiction; they are a key part of the fourth industrial revolution.

Cyber Warfare
The world is entering a new era of warfare, with cyber and autonomous weapons taking center stage. These technologies are making militaries faster, smarter, more efficient. But if unchecked, they threaten to destabilize the world.

Gone are the bayonets and pistols, the bows and arrows, the slingshots and stones of past warfare; people have pushed into the outer limits, into a vast frontier, well beyond earth's atmosphere.

description:
S01 E09 — Gelderland
The team explore reports of paranormal activity in Gelderland, The Netherlands where things take a dark turn as they attempt to make contact with spirits.

The team investigates paranormal activity in the medieval city of Bruges where psychic Ian Lawman makes contact with what he believes to be an executioner.

description:
S02 E03 — Hurricanes '07
Featuring a full-length exploration of a major hurricane making landfall in Florida or the Carolinas.

title: Angry Planet
description:
S02 E01 — B.C. Caving
In the porous limestone of Canada's West Coast, great forces are at work under the ground, building and eroding the underground into fantastic shapes. In this episode we'll witness George's explorations of these massive underground cave systems.

title: Angry Planet
description:
S03 E10 — Hot and Cold Crystals
Miners in Chihuahua, Mexico, discover a chamber filled with blue and pink crystals, some as big as 60 feet long; as temperatures run to 150 F, with 100-percent humidity, the authorities are only opening up the cavern to scientists and film crews.

title: The Aviators
description:
S02 E11 — Aircraft Engines
Bill Middlebrook of Penn Yan Aero discusses aircraft power plants; Lockheed Electra; women in aviation.

title: The Aviators
description:
S02 E12 — AOPA/LAPD/Pete McLeod
Buying a used aircraft; heli-tourism; history of the Soviet passenger plane Antonov An-2.

title: Space Greed
description:
S01 E10 — Above The Law
For the first 50 years of spaceflight, most nations broadly agree that space is common heritage, that it belonged to everybody.

title: Breakthrough
description:
S01 E78 — Reefs of Hope
With new state-of-the-art tools and technologies that include curious underwater vehicles and hydrodynamic modeling, scientists have hope of better understanding the threats to coral communities while finding the source to restock reefs worldwide.

title: Breakthrough
description:
S01 E80 — Fusion: Harnessing the Power of Stars
Humanity is closer than ever before to a perpetual clean power source after a team of scientists at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory successfully produced a nuclear fusion reaction resulting in a net energy gain.

title: Breakthrough
description:
S01 E83 — The Great Seaweed Invasion
A giant mass of floating seaweed is invading popular beaches in the US and the Caribbean; scientists are racing to figure out how to protect the coast while tracking and studying this natural wonder.

title: The Lightbulb Moment
description:
S01 E10 — Edison: How Edison Reinvented Invention
Edison pioneered the world's first research and development center in Menlo Park and worked with a group of experimenters to methodically zero in on the holy grail of electric light.

title: Battle Factory
description:
S01 E09 — The Jaws of Life/ M1 Abrams Tank/ Military Watch
From standard issue to high-tech, this fascinating show reveals how frontline gear is made; the Jaws of Life, the M1 Abrams tank and the military watch are put under the spotlight.

title: Battle Factory
description:
S01 E10 — F16/ Sword/ Simulated Ammunition
Discover the incredible manufacturing skill that goes into making cavalry swords and simulated ammunition; the brainpower that keeps the iconic F-16 fighter jet in the sky.

title: Battle Factory
description:
S01 E11 — Camouflage Makeup, Machine Gun and Amphibious Military
See how camouflage make-up, the M2 machine gun and the Argo amphibious ATV are built to withstand the toughest conditions.

description:
S01 E04 — India - The Search for Mindfulness
We journey to India, a land known for its wisdom and practices; as we navigate through contrasting environments, we discover how meditation is part of daily life; join us for this expedition as we unravel the power of mindfulness.

title: Health Explored
description:
S02 E05 — India - The Search for Mindfulness Part II
Journey to the school of Happiness and learn about Karma in this second part of our India adventure; we travel from the Himalayas back to central Delhi with a new perspective on what mindfulness really means.

title: Health Explored
description:
S02 E06 — Buthan - The Pursuit of Happiness Part I
Bhutan embraces happiness above all else for its citizens; this approach has made Bhutan a model for health around the world; is happiness the key to better health?

Francesca discovers how good today's mobile homes can be; she visits one UK company who specializes in producing top-of-the-line vehicles.
